summary: Banco de Chile filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its interim consolidated financial statements with notes as of September 30, 2026, signed by CEO Eduardo Ebensperger O. The exhibit contains IFRS statements of financial position, income, comprehensive income, cash flows, equity, and standard note disclosures. No special-situation transaction, price, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. This is an ordinary periodic reporting event for a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a domestic quarterly financial filing. What to watch: only operating and credit-quality trends, not deal arbitrage.
